briefdescription.para: Owns a host-supplied uniqueness scope, controller identity/generation, exactly-once consumption, bounded session capacity, and the validation-session lifecycle.

detaileddescription.para: All operations take one internal mutex, so concurrent consumption and transitions serialize into a deterministic total order and exactly-once consumption holds under concurrency. The manager is non-copyable and non-movable. It owns its TimeAuthority and PermitRegistry; destroy the manager before any thread that used it exits. Every public method that returns a value is [[nodiscard]], and every path that fails leaves session state, consumed sets, quota counters, and authority baselines unchanged. The class exposes no emission, transport, journal, or persistence entry point, and emission_count() is always zero. Unit specification: T025-U-MANAGER
